memory_candidates.content: Authoring a '## Lean Challenge Statements' block for a greenfield language: lean-challenge-snapshot.sh matches only the keywords theorem, lemma, def and instance followed by a SIMPLE name, forces that body to sorry, and discards all text between a declaration's ':=' and the next matched declaration (so namespace / end / open / variable lines placed between declarations vanish, and a dotted name like 'TaskFrame.Foo' is recorded as 'TaskFrame'). Keep every carrier in the preamble as inductive or abbrev (unmatched, so bodies survive and stay out of the identifier set), use no dotted declaration names, and switch namespaces only before the first theorem. The Goals identifier range runs from a line starting with bold 'Goals:' to the next line starting with two asterisks plus a non-G character, and captures every backticked simple identifier, so list non-challenge declarations under a separate bold heading. The tool compares a locale-sorted Goals list against a codepoint-sorted declared list: names ranked differently by en_US and C collation (uppercase versus underscore after a shared prefix) give a spurious exit 71; verify with the --dry-run flag in the default locale.
